_doc: Codex CLI host adapter. Packaged skills get agents/openai.yaml with allow_implicit_invocation=false (contract 5). `reviewer` describes the closed-context Codex reviewer child spawned by review.mjs when the author host is Claude (contract 7): read-only sandbox, no native output schema, every execution/delegation surface disabled by feature flag on the command line (adapter JSON → argv is the single effective configuration; there is no config file) and verified by a live negative probe. `project_doc_max_bytes=0` disables AGENTS.md project-doc loading from the reviewer cwd — the live probe (2026-09-05) showed `--ignore-rules` alone does not stop it.

registry._note: Codex exposes no documented installed-root file; the root comes from `codex plugin add --json` or the operator and is validated against the package marker (contract 2).

_hooks_doc: Codex CLI plugin hooks manifest (packaged as hooks/hooks.json). Same runner, same core policies as Claude Code; matchers use the tool names Codex documents (Bash, apply_patch). Codex has no Read/Grep/WebFetch hook events, so read telemetry covers shell reads only, fetches are not audited and the LSP hint has no event (legacy-only). Codex loads plugin hooks only after the operator trusts them; a hooks.json next to inline [hooks] in one layer is loaded twice with a warning — this plugin ships only hooks.json. Commands reference `${PLUGIN_ROOT}`, the environment variable Codex documents for plugin hook commands (`CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` is set too, for compatibility); the shell expands it, and hook-adapters.test.mjs executes every command of this manifest against the built package to prove the path resolves. verified offline: command expansion against the built package, payload parsing, responses; installed-host trust and firing are live-run assertions (hooks-trusted, hooks-fired) Native manifests carry only `description` and `hooks`: Codex rejects any other top-level field (observed 2026-09-06: "unknown field `_doc`").
